landing.heroBody: CoopSetu brings institutions, trainees, skills, certifications, and employment exchange into one unified cooperative training platform.
landing.capTraineeRegistryDesc: One record per trainee — enrolment, batch, attendance and outcomes in a single place.
landing.capQrAttendanceDesc: Mark a session from the door. Works offline and syncs when the device reconnects.
landing.capCoursesDesc: Publish modules, run quizzes, and grade against the same catalogue every batch uses.
landing.capCertificatesDesc: Issue verifiable certificates that anyone can check without an account.
landing.capSkillPassportDesc: A portable, evidence-backed record of what a trainee can actually do.
landing.capEmploymentDesc: Match certified trainees to employer postings on real, recorded skills.
landing.empowerBody: One platform to register, train, certify, and employ — built for institutions aiming to transform cooperative education.
landing.trustIntegrityDesc: Row-level security on every table, so a record is only ever visible to the institution that owns it.
landing.trustSyncDesc: Attendance, results and placements update live across every device in the institution.

about.heading: Operational clarity for institutions providing cooperative training.
about.intro: CoopSetu is a role-aware workspace for managing training batches, tracking trainee attendance, conducting assessments, and connecting trainees with potential employers in real time.
about.p1Body: Institutions, batches, assessments, attendance, and job placements managed in one unified workspace.
about.p2Body: Every action is connected to the right institute, trainer, trainee, role, and digital skill passport.
about.p3Body: NCCT Admins, Institute Admins, Trainers, Trainees, and Employers see only what they are authorized to access.
about.p4Body: Course assignments, attendance updates, assessment results, and job applications update in real-time without manual refresh.
about.p5Body: Show truthful training data and verifiable digital records. Do not invent batches, trainees, metrics, or completion certificates.
about.builtByHeading: CoopSetu is designed and developed by VenomDevX.
about.builtByBody: Focused on building secure, role-aware digital infrastructure for the cooperative training ecosystem.

product.heading: One operational system for teams building critical software.
product.intro: CoopSetu Enterprise connects planning, batch assignment, training, moderation workflows, assessments, security, placements, and AI intelligence in one controlled workspace.
product.alert: Final Assessment for Batch A is blocked by 2 attendance anomalies. Moderation signoff pending for 3 hours.
product.h2Delivery: See delivery work as it happens.
product.deliveryBody: Get an immediate, uncompromising view of institute health, training capacity, and certification risk across all training centers.
product.h2Code: Connect work to the code that ships.
product.codeBody: Integrate directly with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket. Track pull requests, commits, CI/CD pipelines, and deployments from within the task.
product.prBody: Automatically link pull requests to stories and tasks. Block merging if tests fail.
product.ciBody: View build logs, test results, and environment deployments directly on the ticket.
product.envBody: Know exactly which features are deployed to staging, pre-prod, and production.
product.h2Evidence: Ship software with evidence, approvals, and accountability.
product.h2Knowledge: Keep decisions, systems, and delivery knowledge connected.
product.knowledgeBody: Architecture records, API documentation, runbooks, and meeting notes—all version-controlled, access-restricted, and linked directly to project execution.
product.h2Intelligence: Turn operational data into delivery intelligence.
product.intelligenceBody: Executive dashboards for institute health, certification velocity, workload analysis, dropout trends, and placement reliability.
product.h2Replace: Replace disconnected tools with one controlled delivery system.
